subsystem.name: GenericRuntimeObjects
subsystem.responsibility: Cross-cutting runtime helpers: vector/quaternion math, Direct3D-registry and cpuid capability probes, generic dispatch/vtable thunks, state-machine dispatch, stream/format decoders, callback and text-serialization helpers, and the media-surface descriptor/flag/state accessors shared by initialization and packet-encoding paths.

summary: DERIVED grouping of thirty validated functions in the generic_runtime_objects scope. Two are stateless math helpers (plane-from-triangle 0x0050E585, quaternion normalize 0x0050ED19). Three are platform capability probes: a Direct3D registry value query (0x0050FBFC), a cpuid leaf-1 EDX-bit-23 probe (0x0050FC58), and MMX detection with a 'DisableMMX' registry override and a cached state global (0x0050FC7D). Three are thin dispatch/vtable thunks (0x0050EDD2, 0x0050F6F2, 0x00511686). One is a state-machine dispatch wrapper that writes opcodes 18/50 into a vtable-backed target object (0x0050F9AB). One is a stream-based image frame decoder (0x00510012). Three form a callback/serialization layer (0x005117C8 escaped-hex record serializer, 0x00511887 optional callback dispatch, 0x005118C1 two-step delegation). The remaining seventeen are media-surface support helpers all wired through the same caller 0x0050210E: two guarded dispatch routines (0x00511B5C, 0x00511F23), six guard-gated descriptor field readers (0x0051212E, 0x00512144, 0x0051215A, 0x00512183, 0x0051227F, 0x005122B2), PNG width-overflow validation (0x005121AE), four flag/state setters over this+0x60/0x61/0x117 (0x00512319, 0x00512322, 0x00512334, 0x005124D5), a composite state setter (0x00512366), and the packet-format encoder (0x005124DE). Two pixel byte-swap helpers (0x005123B3, 0x005123E0) share a separate caller 0x0051389E. The packet names owners only for 0x005118C1 (CallbackDispatchLayer) and 0x005121AE (PngImageValidation); every other owner is UNKNOWN in the packet, so all remaining classes are proposed GUESS groupings by shared caller and shared field base, not attested source layout.

function_roles.role: Plane-from-triangle helper: builds a float[4] plane (normal + offset) from three corners via the cross product of edges (a2-a3) and (a2-a4), writes normal components to offsets 0x0/0x4/0x8, invokes ThunkTo (0x0050C2B3), then writes the offset -dot(normal,a2) to 0xC and returns the output pointer.

Quaternion normalizer: computes the squared norm of a2, returns a straight copy (or nothing) when FloatRangeCheck(0x0050C042) reports unit length, scales by 1/sqrt(norm) above the 1.1754944e-38 threshold, and zeroes all four outputs at or below it; every path writes all four components of a1.

Sequential thunk wrapper: calls ThunkViaFunctionPointer (0x0050DD3A) with three float arguments and a pointer to a local 4-int stack buffer, then calls ThunkToIndirectCallViaDAT005d7860 (0x0050D857) which dispatches through the function pointer at 005d7860; returns a1 unchanged.

Forwarding thunk: passes its single argument unchanged to sub_516959 and returns that result verbatim; no computation, guard, or field access. Teardown role is inferred only from the canonical name and the caller ImageTextureDecompressor (0x00501722).

State-machine dispatch with extended result handling: reads the state at this+0x10; for states other than 200 and 201 writes opcode 18 to the target object's code slot (obj+0x14) with the state as argument (obj+0x18) and dispatches through the target vtable, then delegates to StateMachineDispatch (0x0050F86A); returns 1 when the inner dispatch returns 1, and on a result of 2 with flag a2 set writes opcode 50, dispatches it, calls VirtualDispatchConditionalValue (0x00516937) and returns 2; other inner results propagate unchanged.

Direct3D registry value query: opens HKLM\Software\Microsoft\Direct3D via RegOpenKeyA, queries the named value via RegQueryValueExA, closes the key, and returns TRUE only when both the open and query return ERROR_SUCCESS and the stored registry type equals the expected type parameter a1.
cpuid feature probe (stdcall): executes cpuid with EAX=1 and returns whether EDX bit 23 (mask 0x800000) is set, i.e. whether the probed feature flag is present.

MMX capability detection with registry override: on a successful open of Software\Microsoft\Direct3D, a present 'DisableMMX' REG_DWORD (type 4) with non-zero data forces the cached state dword_5D7994 to 0 and returns 0; otherwise, when the cache is negative (uninitialized), it runs the CPU probe via sub_50FC58, emits EMMS when MMX is available, and stores 1 or 0 into dword_5D7994; returns the cached state.

State-machine-driven frame decoder: consumes a byte stream through a refillable stream object (a2+20), parses an 8-byte big-endian header (length, metadata, width, height, count), decodes count 3-byte elements into 84-byte records, publishes color vectors and status codes (99/57/31/9/100), persists the stream position, and returns 1 on success or 0 on a failed refill; refill callback, vtable handlers, and allocator are indirect.

Vtable dispatch thunk: reads the vtable pointer at this+0, allocates a 200-byte stack buffer, dispatches through vtable entry +0xC with (a1, buffer), and returns the virtual call's result; no other side effects.

cdecl text serializer: iterates four bytes at a1+268, escaping bytes outside the printable alphanumeric range as '[' + two hex digits from the byte_5AF210 lookup + ']', otherwise copying them verbatim; when a2 is non-null appends ': ' and a 0x40-byte payload with the 64th byte forced to 0, otherwise appends a null terminator; returns the end-of-buffer pointer.
Optional callback dispatch: loads the function pointer at this+0x44; when non-null invokes it with (receiver, argument) and returns its result, otherwise returns NULL; no side effects on failure.

Two-step delegation wrapper: calls WriteEscapedHexRecord (0x005117C8) with (a1, a2), then calls CallbackDispatch (0x00511887) with (a1, &stack_buffer) and returns the produced function pointer; the 80-byte stack buffer is used only as an output area.

Guarded dispatch: when bit 0x40 of the flag byte at this+0x5C is clear, recalculates the audio buffer size via AudioBufferSizeCalc (0x0051868C); always dispatches PacketFieldEncoding (0x005124DE) with (a1, a2) and returns its result.

Repeated element dispatch: queries the iteration count via FlagBasedSessionModeSelector (0x0051234D), copies the element count from this+0xBC to this+0xC0, and when the selector returns a positive count runs a nested loop calling sub_511B7C(a1, *v5++, 0) over the a2 pointer array; returns the last sub_511B7C result or the selector result when the loops do not run.

Null-guarded field read: returns the dword at *(a2+12) when both a1 and a2 are non-null, otherwise 0; a1 is only tested for non-null. In the caller the value becomes the row stride of a media-surface context.
Guard-conditional byte-field reader: returns the unsigned byte at a2+29 when both object pointers a1 and a2 are non-null, otherwise 0; no side effects.
Flag-guarded float-to-double reader: returns 0 unless a1, a2, a3 are non-null and bit 0 of the dword at a2+8 is set; on success writes the float at a2+40 into the caller's double *a3 and returns 1.

Flag-guarded byte-field reader with constant success code: returns 0 when a1, a2, or a3 is null or bit 0x800 of the dword at a2+8 is clear; on success writes the unsigned byte at a2+44 into *a3 and returns the constant 2048.

PNG width-overflow validation: reads width/height and color-description bytes from source struct a2 into output pointers, computes a bytes-per-row factor from the color-type byte, and when the width would overflow 0x7FFFFFFF / ((factor * bitDepth + 7) >> 3) dispatches the aWidthTooLargeF error string via CallbackDispatch (0x00511887); always returns 1 after validation, or 0 when any of a1..a6 is null.

Guard-gated field reader: validates a1, the state pointer a2, enable bit 0x08 of the byte at a2+8, and output pointer a3, then copies the dword at a2+16 into *a3 and the 16-bit field at a2+20 into *a4, returning 8 on success or 0 when any guard fails.

Format-gated media descriptor query: requires a1, a2, and enable bit 0x10 of the byte at a2+8, then branches on the format discriminator byte at a2+25; format 3 exposes the dword at a2+48 into *a3 and sets result 16, other formats zero *a3; both branches write the descriptor pointer a2+52 into *a5; when a4 is present its word at a2+22 is written and the 0x10 bit is OR-ed into the returned result.
Unconditionally ORs bit 0 (0x1) into the flags DWORD at this+0x60 via read-modify-write and returns the this pointer; called by sub_50210E (0x0050210E).
Sets bit 0x10 on the flags DWORD at this+0x60 when the animation-state byte at this+0x117 equals 16; returns the object pointer a1 unchanged.
When the state byte at this+0x117 is below 8, ORs bit 4 (value 4) into the flags DWORD at this+0x60 and writes 8 to the state byte at this+0x118; always returns the input a1.

State-flags setter: sets bit 7 of the flags byte at this+0x61, stores the byte parameter a2 as a WORD at this+0x11E, toggles bit 7 of the flags byte at this+0x5C by the boolean a3, and derives the output state byte at this+0x11B (4 when the state byte at 0x116 equals 2; 2 when it equals 0 and the state byte at 0x117 is >= 8); returns the object pointer.

Conditional adjacent-byte-pair swap: when the enable byte at this+0x9 equals 16 and the product of the dword count at this+0x0 and the stride byte at this+0xA is non-zero, swaps each adjacent byte pair of a2 over count*stride iterations advancing two bytes at a time.

Conditional pixel byte swap gated on bit 1 (mask 2) of the format flags byte at this+0x8: at 8bpp swaps bytes [0] and [2] of each group with stride 3 (flags 2) or 4 (flags 6); at 16bpp swaps bytes [0]<->[4] and [1]<->[5] with stride 6 (flags 2) or 8 (flags 6); the iteration count is the element count at this+0x0.
Sets bit 4 (mask 0x10) on the flags byte at this+0x61 and returns the object pointer unchanged; unconditional bit-set called by sub_50210E (0x0050210E).

Packet-format encoder: rewrites the output packet's encoding byte (a2+25) and bit depth byte (a2+24) from session flag bits at this+0x60/0x61 and configuration words at this+0x10A/0x174, copies the camera-rotation DWORD at this+0x130 into the packet when the video flag is set, computes the per-sample stride (a2+29) and bytes-per-sample product (a2+30), and stores the encoded size (a2+12), which it returns.

classes.name: MathVectorHelpers
classes.responsibility: Stateless vector/quaternion math helpers that produce a float[4] output buffer: a plane-from-triangle constructor and a quaternion normalizer with a unit-length fast path, a scale path, and a zero path.

classes.name: PlatformCapabilityProbe
classes.responsibility: Static platform capability queries: Direct3D registry value lookup under HKLM\Software\Microsoft\Direct3D, a cpuid leaf-1 EDX-bit-23 probe, and MMX detection that honors a 'DisableMMX' registry override and caches the enabled state in the global dword_5D7994.

classes.name: GenericDispatchThunks
classes.responsibility: Thin dispatch and vtable thunks with no computation of their own: a sequential two-call thunk, a single-argument forwarding thunk, and a vtable-entry dispatch that routes through the object's vtable slot +0xC.

classes.name: StateMachineDispatchController
classes.responsibility: Owns a state-machine dispatch wrapper that reads its own state (this+0x10), writes opcodes into a vtable-backed target object, delegates to an inner state-machine dispatch (0x0050F86A), and handles the extended result-2 completion path.

classes.name: CommandDispatchTarget
classes.responsibility: The vtable-backed object that receives state-machine dispatch writes: an opcode is stored in its code slot (+0x14), an argument in its argument slot (+0x18), and it is invoked through its vtable at +0. Only inferred from StateMachineDispatch_f9ab's writes; the class identity behind the target vtable is unknown.

classes.name: StreamMediaDecoder
classes.responsibility: Decodes packed image-frame data from a refillable byte stream: parses an 8-byte big-endian header, allocates an 84-byte-per-element buffer, decodes count 3-byte elements, and publishes header/element status codes and color vectors through the owning object's vtable.

classes.name: CallbackDispatchLayer
classes.responsibility: Callback and serialization helpers: an optional per-object callback slot (this+0x44) dispatched with (receiver, argument), a two-step delegation wrapper over that dispatch, and an escaped-hex text serializer used as a shared record-formatting step.

classes.name: MediaSurfaceContext
classes.responsibility: Session/media-surface context manipulated by the InitializeMediaSurfaceFromStream helper cluster (shared caller 0x0050210E): format/encoding flag words (this+0x60/0x61), driver/animation state bytes (this+0x116..0x11E), and packet-size/rotation configuration used by the packet-format encoder. Common ownership of the this-based offsets is inferred from the shared caller, not proven.

classes.name: MediaDescriptorState
classes.responsibility: Guard-gated descriptor field accessors over an a2 state/descriptor object: every accessor validates an enable pointer, the state pointer, a flag bit in the state object (bits 0x01/0x08/0x10/0x800 at +8), and output pointers, then copies one or more typed fields and returns a fixed success code (1, 8, 16, or 2048). Equal offsets recur across accessors but common ownership is inferred only from the shared caller 0x0050210E.

classes.name: PngImageValidation
classes.responsibility: Validates PNG-style image dimensions read from a source struct: computes a bytes-per-row factor from the color-type byte and guards against row-size overflow, dispatching the 'Width too large for libpng...' message through the callback layer when the width is too large.

classes.name: PixelFormatByteSwapper
classes.responsibility: Conditional byte-pair swaps over pixel/audio buffers driven by a format descriptor (element count +0x0, flags +0x8, bits-per-pixel +0x9, stride +0xA): an adjacent-pair endianness-style swap and a channel-geometry pixel swap gated on flag bit 1. Caller sub_51389E owns the descriptor layout.

state_machines.name: DispatchStateMachine
transitions: When the state at this+0x10 is not 200 or 201: write opcode 18 to the target code slot (obj+0x14) with the state as argument (obj+0x18) and dispatch through the target vtable, then delegate to StateMachineDispatch (0x0050F86A).
States 200 and 201 skip the opcode-18 pre-dispatch and go straight to StateMachineDispatch.
Inner result 2 with flag a2 non-zero: write opcode 50 to obj+0x14, dispatch it, call VirtualDispatchConditionalValue (0x00516937), return 2.
Inner result 2 with flag a2 zero and other inner results propagate unchanged.

state_machines.name: ImageDecodeStatusProtocol
transitions: On header parse success: publish header, set status 99, notify via vtable +4.
If the decoded flag byte is already set: set status 57 and invoke the vtable slot-0 handler.
If width or height is zero or count <= 0: set status 31 and invoke the vtable slot-0 handler.
If the body length v42 != 3 * count: set status 9 and invoke the vtable slot-0 handler.
For each decoded element: publish the color vector, set status 100, notify via vtable +4.
On completion: set the decoded flag byte and persist the stream position.

interfaces.name: IMediaDescriptorQuery
interfaces.purpose: Guard-gated query protocol over a descriptor/state object: every accessor validates an enable pointer, the state object, and output pointers plus a flag bit in the state object, then copies one or more typed fields and returns a fixed success code (1, 8, 16, or 2048); failures return 0. Callers branch on the distinct success codes.

interfaces.name: IHardwareCapabilityProbe
interfaces.purpose: Platform capability queries: Direct3D registry value lookup under HKLM\Software\Microsoft\Direct3D and cpuid-based CPU feature detection with an MMX enable cache and a 'DisableMMX' registry override.

interfaces.name: IStateMachineDispatchProtocol
interfaces.purpose: Dispatch protocol over a vtable-backed command target: the controller reads its own state, writes an opcode into the target's code slot (+0x14) with an argument (+0x18), and dispatches through the target vtable; extended results route through additional virtual handling.

compatibility_contracts.name: Direct3DRegistryQuerySemantics
compatibility_contracts.description: A replacement must open HKLM\Software\Microsoft\Direct3D with RegOpenKeyA, query a caller-supplied value name with RegQueryValueExA, close the key, and return TRUE only when both the open and the query report ERROR_SUCCESS and the stored registry type equals the expected type argument; otherwise FALSE.

compatibility_contracts.name: DisableMMXRegistryOverride
compatibility_contracts.description: When the value 'DisableMMX' is present as REG_DWORD (type 4) with non-zero data under HKLM\Software\Microsoft\Direct3D, MMX must be reported disabled and the cached state dword_5D7994 forced to 0; otherwise, on first call, the cpuid probe result is cached (1 enabled / 0 disabled) and the EMMS instruction is emitted when MMX is available.

compatibility_contracts.name: CpuidLeaf1EdxBit23Probe
compatibility_contracts.description: The capability probe must execute cpuid with EAX=1 and expose whether EDX bit 23 (mask 0x800000) is set as a boolean; the specific feature named by that bit is not established.

compatibility_contracts.name: CommandDispatchObjectProtocol
compatibility_contracts.description: The state-machine dispatch writes an opcode (18 on the pre-dispatch path, 50 on the extended path) into the target object's code slot at +0x14, its argument at +0x18, and dispatches through the target vtable at +0; a replacement that drives or consumes these objects must preserve that layout, the state bypass values 200/201, and the extended result-2 path (opcode 50 plus VirtualDispatchConditionalValue).

compatibility_contracts.name: PacketFieldEncodingSemantics
compatibility_contracts.description: The output packet's encoding byte (values 2, 3, and 6), bit-depth byte (8 or 16, with downgrade rules), per-sample stride byte, and total size DWORD must be computed from the session flag bytes at this+0x60/0x61 and the configuration words at this+0x10A/0x174 as documented; the camera-rotation DWORD at this+0x130 is copied into the packet when the video flag is set. A replacement consumer of these packets must match the encoding and sizing rules.

compatibility_contracts.name: PngWidthOverflowGuard
compatibility_contracts.description: PNG width validation must compute the bytes-per-row factor from the color-type byte and reject a width exceeding 0x7FFFFFFF / ((factor * bitDepth + 7) >> 3) by dispatching the 'Width too large for libpng to process image data.' message through the callback dispatch, while still returning 1 after validation; a null among the first six arguments returns 0.

compatibility_contracts.name: GuardedDescriptorAccessorReturnCodes
compatibility_contracts.description: Guard-gated descriptor accessors return distinct fixed success codes (1, 8, 16, and 2048) that callers branch on; a replacement must preserve the exact codes, the null guards (enable pointer, state object, output pointers), and the flag-bit gates (bits 0x01/0x08/0x10/0x800 of the state object), because callers distinguish them.

unresolved: All owners except CallbackDispatchLayer (0x005118C1) and PngImageValidation (0x005121AE) are UNKNOWN in the packet; the GUESS classes are per-function groupings by shared caller and shared field base, not attested source layout.
MediaSurfaceContext groups this-based flag/state helpers that share offsets 0x60/0x61/0x117 but are linked only by the shared caller 0x0050210E; common ownership is inferred, not proven.
MediaDescriptorState groups a2-based accessors whose equal offsets (notably the flag word at +8 and the 0x10 return bit) recur across functions; whether they share one struct layout is unproven.
Which of flt_59E43C (0x0059E43C) and flt_5ADE40 (0x005ADE40) backs the 1.0 literal and which backs 1.1754944e-38 in QuaternionNormalize is DERIVED and unproven.
FloatRangeCheck (0x0050C042) applies epsilon literals defined in that function, which is outside this packet.
sub_516959 (forwarded by 0x0050F6F2) has no callee evidence ref; its destructor/teardown role is inferred only from the canonical name and the caller ImageTextureDecompressor (0x00501722).

ThunkTo (0x0050C2B3) is called between the normal writes and the offset write in PlaneFromTriangle; it may be a null/nop thunk or may mutate registers the compiler keeps in live values, and its effect is unknown.

The stream decoder (0x00510012) refill callback (v3[3]), the vtable handlers at (*(a2)) slot 0 and +4, and the allocator vtable are indirect with no static addresses; the status codes 99/57/31/9/100 are opaque protocol values. The packet summary names its caller CommandDispatchStateMachine (0x0051126A), but that address carries no evidence ref in the packet.

The 84-byte (21-dword) element record stride in ImageFormatStreamDecoder and the 3-bytes-per-element stream layout are derived from loop arithmetic only; only element indices 0..4 are written and the underlying pixel format is unconfirmed.

The targets and purposes of TwoThunkWrapper's two thunks (ThunkViaFunctionPointer 0x0050DD3A and the indirect call through function pointer 005d7860) and the meaning of the forwarded float triple are unresolved.
The specific CPU feature named by cpuid EDX bit 23 (mask 0x800000) is not identified in the packet.

The registry import globals (0x0059E004 RegQueryValueExA, 0x0059E008 RegCloseKey, 0x0059E044 RegOpenKeyA) and the subkey/value strings at 0x005ADE4C/0x005ADE68 ('Software\Microsoft\Direct3D', 'DisableMMX') are interpreted from raw-source usage; the identity of the owning rendering object that caches MMX state is unknown.

WriteEscapedHexRecord's buffer base (v2/ecx uninitialized in decompiler output), the meaning of the four bytes at a1+268, and the layout of the 0x40-byte payload copied from a2 are unknown; byte_5AF210 is assumed to be a hex-digit table but its contents are not evidenced.
The callback slot at this+0x44 has no registration site or owner type in evidence; the exact call convention of the stored callback (receiver as argument vs. implicit this) is unresolved.

PixelFormatByteSwapper's descriptor layout (count 0x0, flags 0x8, bpp 0x9, stride 0xA) and the true purpose of the 16bpp byte-pair swap (0<->4, 1<->5) are unknown; the RGB<->BGR channel-swap reading is DERIVED from the swap geometry, and caller sub_51389E owns the semantics.

The media-surface initialization function 0x0050210E (the shared caller of the MediaSurfaceContext and MediaDescriptorState clusters) is outside this packet, so the calling context for those helpers is caller-side and unverified.
State-machine semantics of the bypass states 200/201 and of opcodes 18 and 50 written to the command target are not in the packet; the class identity behind the target vtable is unknown.
The 0x40-size flag on this+0x5C and the audio-buffer-size meaning of AudioBufferSizeCalc (0x0051868C) rest on corpus names; their runtime behavior is not verified in this packet.
Whether the returned normal from PlaneFromTriangle is normalized or unit-scaled is not shown by that function; normalization, if any, must occur elsewhere.
